title: Cottage 62
meta_description: Short Walk to Beach and Seaside- Cottage 62 by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Cottage 62 by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 62 Canal Street Details: Cottage 62 is a charming, completely renovated bungalow tucked away in Old Seagrove Beach. Thoughtfully appointed and lovingly maintained, this 1,144-square-foot retreat comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests with three bedrooms and two full baths. The open, vaulted living area creates a bright and welcoming space for gathering, while the fully equipped kitchen, quartz countertops, and comfortable furnishings make this cottage an ideal choice for a relaxed 30A getaway. The neighborhood beach access is approximately a five-minute stroll from the home, while Seaside is just half a mile away and easily reached by bike. Guests are also conveniently located near WaterColor Crossing and the beloved Seagrove Village Market, just two blocks away. With its inviting interiors, convenient location, and classic Old Seagrove charm, Cottage 62 is perfectly suited for families looking to experience the laid-back lifestyle of 30A. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 5-Minute Walk -Distance to Seaside: Approximately 0.5 Miles -Parking Spaces: (3) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Counter Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Open, Vaulted Living Area -Luxurious Tuft & Needle Mattresses -Outdoor Deck -Outdoor Gas Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 3 Bedrooms / 2 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area Please Note: *On-street parking is not permitted. The property accommodates a maximum of (3) vehicles. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
